The '''HYd-997 hyperdrive motivator''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]]. The unit was installed in the company's [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing]]<ref name="EGVV" /> and [[B-wing/E starfighter|B-wing/E]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The HYd-997 was a reliable and efficient [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Class Two]] unit.<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|BWI 1-2|B-Wing}}</ref>
